bio: There’s no denying that a meal at Csopaki Resti by Laurel provides something a little different: this tiny restaurant comprises just 10 seats and sits within the old village railway station. Little sister to Laurel in Budapest, its multi-course set menu follows the same ethos, with dishes taking on a modern edge while still keeping traditional Hungarian flavours to the fore. Because of its compact size, every diner can watch the chefs preparing the dishes in the on-view kitchen, but the four counter seats are undeniably the best place to be. Wherever you sit, the chefs will serve you personally....
